SELECT COUNT(*) FROM theme t WHERE t.status = 'ON_SALE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_purchase (member_id, theme_id, payment_id, is_used) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{themeId}, NULL, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.theme_name, t.price, t.thumbnail_url, t.theme_code, TRUE AS is_owned, CASE WHEN m.theme_id = t.id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_applied FROM theme_purchase tp INNER JOIN theme t ON t.id = tp.theme_id INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = tp.member_id WHERE tp.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM theme_purchase tp INNER JOIN theme t ON t.id = tp.theme_id WHERE tp.member_id = #{memberId}
